name: Parameters.frob_iff_eq_frobElem_pow
summary: By `frob_ext`, the condition is: v is the place of e·p^n (powers of the primitive root φ(ζ(P, s)) are distinct in the domain R) and χ_K(p)^n·e = 1 in R; as −1 ≠ 1 in R this means e = χ_K(p)^n, i.e. (v, e) = frobElem^n.

steps.claim: p ∤ N₁(P, s)·d(P) means p ∤ N₁(P, s) and p ∤ d(P) (p is prime).
Record: N₁(P, s) ≠ 0 in R (char R = p ∤ N₁(P, s)); χ_K(p) = 0 with p = d(P), or p ≠ d(P) with χ_K(p) = ±1 (`chiK_cases`); p ≠ 2 (2 ∣ N₁(P, s)); and n is even or odd.
steps.lean:
rcases of_not_dvd R hc.1, chiK_cases P.d p, (hc.1 <| · ▸ by grind [Parameters] : p ≠ 2),
    em (Even n)

steps.claim: By `frob_ext` the left side says φ(galOfPlace(P, s)(v) ζ(P, s)) = φ(galOfPlace(P, s)(u) ζ(P, s)), u = placeOfInt(P, s, e·p^n), and χ_K(p)^n·e·φ(√−d(P)) = φ(√−d(P)). Since φ(ζ(P, s)) is a root of Φ_{N₁(P, s)} in the domain R with N₁(P, s) ≠ 0 there, it is a primitive N₁(P, s)-th root and its powers ζ(P, s)^a, 0 ≤ a < N₁(P, s), are distinct; with galOfPlace(P, s)(x)(ζ(P, s)) = ζ(P, s)^{class of x} (`galOfPlace_zeta`) the first condition says that v and u have the same class in (ℤ/N₁(P, s))^×, i.e. v = u. On the right, frobElem(P, s, p)^n = (placeOfInt(P, s, (χ_K(p)·p)^n), χ_K(p)^n).
steps.lean:
simp [val_lt, (val_injective _).eq_iff, Units.val_inj, (isRoot_cyclotomic_iff.1 (map_cyclotomic _
    φ ▸ (isPrimitiveRoot_zetaInt.isRoot_cyclotomic one_le).map)).injOn_pow.eq_iff,
    frob_ext hc.1 φ n he, (Subtype.ext (galOfPlace_zeta _) : galOfPlaceInt _ (zetaInt ..) =
    zetaInt .. ^ _), mul_left_eq_self₀, placeClass, mul_pow]

steps.claim: φ(√−d(P)) ≠ 0 in R: its square is φ(−d(P)) = −d(P), nonzero since p ∤ d(P) (`map_sqrtNegDInt_sq`).

Split all cases (the value of χ_K(p), the two cases of he, the parity of n): χ_K(p)^n·e·φ(√−d(P)) = φ(√−d(P)) means χ_K(p)^n·e = 1 in R, i.e. e = χ_K(p)^n since −1 ≠ 1 in R (characteristic p ≠ 2); together with v = placeOfInt(P, s, e·p^n) this is (v, e) = frobElem(P, s, p)^n.
